_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: At evening two walked the road, talking of all that had happened.
A stranger drew near and walked with them.
He opened the scriptures until their hearts burned.
He broke the bread, and they knew him.
On the mountain God spreads a feast and wipes away every tear.
Death is swallowed up forever.
Christ is risen!
Christ is risen, alleluia!

registers.label: Immersive
lines: The day is far spent and the road has been long; come in from the dusk and sit at the table, friends.
Christ is risen, alleluia!
Watch the stranger take the bread, give thanks, break it — and feel how your heart was burning all along the way.
Christ is risen, alleluia!
This is the feast the prophet saw on the mountain, the cup poured out, the tears wiped from every face.
Christ is risen, alleluia!
So stay, for it is evening, and the Lord is known to us in the breaking of the bread.
Christ is risen, alleluia!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: At evening two walked the road, and a stranger joined them.
Christ is risen, alleluia!
He broke the bread, and their eyes were opened.
Christ is risen, alleluia!
Their hearts had been burning all along the way.
Christ is risen, alleluia!
Stay with us, Lord; it is evening. Come, let us worship.
Christ is risen, alleluia!
